asset_database_version: allenai/procthor commit d4c4c6a9fdd9679c8b9343d771c510016cd310df (last change to the file, 2022-07-25); 109 object types, 1,653 assets
notes: Brainstorm list; not reviewed tasks. asset_ids and object_type are exact entries in the asset database; state_flags are the union of primaryProperty and secondaryProperties of the listed assets. goal_predicates use AI2-THOR object-state names (isOpen, isToggled, isDirty, isFilledWithLiquid, isSliced, isCooked, isUsedUp, isBroken) plus simple relations. Cabinet, Drawer, StoveBurner, StoveKnob, CounterTop parts and Bathtub are baked into iTHOR room prefabs and are not in the ProcTHOR asset DB, so they appear only in other_objects. THOR states are simulator booleans: real collection needs a physical articulation source (e.g. PartNet-Mobility or a real appliance) and a declared observation of the state. Slicing, cooking, and heat-source ideas are simulation-only or use surrogates as stated in each safety field. Scenes prefixed 'new: ' and intents prefixed 'new: ' are proposals; concepts with concept_is_new are proposed object_* concepts. Several object types appear twice with different assets and rooms.
